name: com.ainimator.controller
description: Real-time runtime for the AI-nimator deterministic autoregressive controller, powered by Unity Sentis. Loads a frozen controller bundle (controller.onnx + norm_stats.json + manifest.json + presets) exported by the ainimator Python pipeline and drives it one forward-pass per frame. Defines no model: it consumes the bundle as-is (see apps/spec/inference_contract.md, the single source of truth for the I/O contract). Includes button->preset authoring (B3) and foot-lock IK + idle/move blending post-processing (B4).

samples.description: A capsule driven by WASD -> ControlPreset bindings (forward/backward/strafe/idle), no IK. Drop CapsuleDemoBootstrap into an empty scene and press Play; it self-configures a capsule + ground + camera and loads the bundle from StreamingAssets/AInimatorBundle.
